Our Experience
Guides The Way.
Viserion Grain, LLC is a newly formed grain company with a highly experienced leadership team. Our purpose is to use this experience to connect local producers to the agricultural value chain both domestically and internationally. With a background in managing river assets we understand the needs not only of producers but also consumers whether domestic or export.
MISSION
Empowering our people to help feed the world responsibly.
VISION
To be the most trusted agribusiness partner, united to deliver value and exceptional customer service.
VALUES
Strive for Customer Success: We put ourselves in our customers’ shoes to understand their goals, hurdles and needs. We collaborate openly and create solutions that deliver lasting value. We keep our commitments and respond to feedback.
Embrace Growth & Progress: We stay curious, ask questions and learn continuously. We set clear goals, measure what matters and share both wins and lessons learned. We challenge the status quo, try new ideas, and drive positive change.
Build Trust: We put safety first in every decision to protect people, partners and communities. We own our actions, follow through and hold each other accountable to do what’s right. We steward resources wisely to build a sustainable future.
We seek to provide a customer-focused approach and a suite of marketing, transportation and storage services to enhance opportunities for our producers.
Our geographic spread, from northern Iowa to southern Louisiana, and our strong commercial management gives us a comprehensive view of the market and provides us with logistical flexibility that few independent companies can replicate.
With experienced teams locally at each facility we will continue to build on existing relationships, establish new ones, and grow together with the communities we serve.
